name: Nirmali–Supaul National Highway
significance: NH 327A is a branch of NH 327. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Nirmali to Supaul, and it meets NH 327 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 327 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Police Colony to Bhadrapur
